Update: the algebraic-factor-base successor is now merged and sealed at source pin `66c97c88dff582ccb8d37613f754ecc0e9430728`. Evidence PR: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/210

Unlike the separate pseudo-random subgroup-base experiments, this run keeps the target-independent Frobenius-union/two-torsion-saturation recipe and exact five public n=41 targets. Three-summand collection derives and certifies 29 factor-base logs; a walked two-summand individual descent then solves all five targets. Two fresh hosted runs show an online post-precomputation crossover over signed-Frobenius rho (2.05x and 1.46x faster), but discovery/relations/logs amortized over five targets are still 28.86x slower, and fresh build plus science are 208.53x the rho wall. No full-cost, asymptotic, novelty, or SOTA claim is made.

An independent check of whether the algebraic boundary and novelty classification are stated correctly would be especially useful.

The second hosted algebraic-walk run is now archived with an explicit source-equivalence audit: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/213

The two commits are not called whole-tree replicas. All Koblitz/IC-relevant Git objects are identical; six changed paths only add unrelated quasi-subfield research. Both runs reproduce identical factor-base/log/target/probe/rho counters, with online IC speedups over rho of 2.05x and 1.46x. Amortized and full available costs remain worse, and no SOTA claim is made.

Stage 39 has now completed and independently replayed from its downloaded artifact.

The n=41 factor base is fixed algebraically as the two-torsion saturation of the Frobenius union of `span(1,x,...,x^5)`. Its measured construction used 0 target samples, 0 scalar labels, and no target-subgroup enumeration. All 29 factor-base logs were derived from 35 collected relations and group-certified; five fresh public hash-to-curve targets had no constructed or supplied scalar.

On the singleton Linux run, precomputation was 4.310245293 s, five descents were 0.259641126 s, and same-target signed-Frobenius rho was 0.909280906 s. Thus online descent was 3.502x faster than rho, while the complete amortized IC cost was still 5.0258x slower. Fresh build plus science was 110.79x the rho wall. Peak sampled process-tree RSS was 1,672,077,312 bytes and charged build-plus-science CPU was 325.176 core-seconds.

Evidence: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/221
Run: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34699822015

This remains a finite internal constant improvement, not a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA claim. Licensed same-instance Magma execution and unaffiliated reproduction/novelty review remain open.

Stage 40 adds a same-instance ABBA parallelism control around the fixed algebraic n=41 workflow: one core, four cores, four cores, one core.

All four cells produced identical factor-base columns, 63 relations from 147,456 probes, 21,970,944 charged summand lookups, target points, recovered scalars, descent trials, rho iterations/additions, and group-verification flags. Median precompute wall was 5.339 s on one core and 2.011 s on four cores (2.66x faster). Complete five-target IC wall improved from 5.978 s to 2.480 s (2.41x). Median process CPU rose from 5.257 to 6.766 core-seconds (1.287x cost). The four-core algorithm remained 3.606x slower than matched rho amortized.

Evidence: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/224
Run: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34700889826

The fixed factor base still uses zero discovery target samples or scalar labels, and no subgroup enumeration. Fresh build plus one median four-core cell remains about 139.55x the matched rho wall. This is a finite parallel latency improvement, not a full-cost crossover or Koblitz index-calculus SOTA claim; licensed Magma and unaffiliated reproduction remain open.

The n=53 boundary and same-target successor are now archived and independently replayed from the downloaded artifact.

The original public-synthetic pointwise direct arm took 873.382 s versus 5.267 s for rho. A retained tuning ladder removed 7.24 billion per-query canonicalization maps, moved to signed-expanded four-summand pair-pair collection, and selected eta 1/128. On the tuning seed direct wall fell to 21.520 s; neighboring eta values and a wider query batch were measured and retained as rejections.

The hosted same-target run gave both producers the identical public Q=(2565091273463387,5885236316843894), with scalar retained only for validation. Both recovered d=476811900269. Direct used 9,964 factor-base points, 94 orbit columns, and 189 group-verified relations; it took 39.781 s wall. Packed signed-Frobenius rho took 3.279 s, so direct remained 12.131x slower. Clean build plus both arms charged 126.968 sequential wall-seconds, 272.392 core-seconds, and 1,718,968,320 bytes peak sampled process-tree RSS.

Hosted run: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34705118094

The current boundary ledger and seven-gate audit are now updated through the n=53 same-target result.

Current verified frontier:
- n=41 fixed-algebraic online IC/rho = 0.2855, but amortized IC remains 5.0258x slower; four-core amortized wall remains 3.6055x slower.
- n=53 exact same-target direct/rho whole-process wall = 12.1313x loss; fresh build plus direct = 37.6983x rho.
- finite coverage now includes unknown-scalar n=31/n=41, known-answer same-target n=53, and PDP-only n=59.

Stage 44/45 update (public synthetic n=53, no SOTA claim): the deterministic four-core pair-pair collector and its current gate audit are now merged in PRs #232, #235, and #236.

On GitHub-hosted runner 34707644672, sequential and parallel arms used the same algebraic factor base, public target Q=(2565091273463387, 5885236316843894), public validation scalar 476811900269, and emitted the same 189 exact group-verified relation hashes. Sequential direct took 48.358874 wall seconds / 48.351887 core-seconds. Four-core direct took 30.635297 wall seconds / 71.702475 core-seconds, a 1.578535x wall speedup with 1.482930x CPU. Peak RSS was 1,525,882,880 bytes. Same-target automorphism rho took 5.127547 wall seconds / 5.126917 core-seconds, so parallel direct remained 5.974650x slower; fresh build plus parallel direct remained 25.281709x slower. The full workflow charged 183.250607 sequential wall seconds, 472.971945 core-seconds, and 1,709,301,760 bytes maximum sampled process-tree RSS.

PR #237 has since merged a scratch-buffer optimization after exact local A/B controls, and hosted run 34709425290 is measuring it on the same target. Unknown-scalar n=53, a licensed same-instance Magma comparison, and unaffiliated reproduction/novelty review remain open. The current result is an engineering improvement and finite research control, not a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA.

Stages 46–52 optimization update (public synthetic n=53, no SOTA claim): PRs #237, #238, #240, #241, and #242 are merged, and the scratch/width artifacts plus current seven-gate audit are sealed in the repository.

The preferred collector now uses persistent per-worker scratch, 4,096-cursor waves, and lazy loading of pair labels. The latest hosted run 34711534312 preserved the same algebraic factor base, public Q=(2565091273463387,5885236316843894), validation scalar 476811900269, rank endpoint, and all 189 exact group-verified relation hashes.

Current measurements: 4,096-cursor direct took 26.408147 wall seconds / 61.058406 core-seconds with 1,392,087,040-byte peak RSS. It charged 85,699,806 support queries and 28,308 batch inversions. Same-target signed-Frobenius rho took 5.111594 seconds, so direct remains 5.166323x slower; fresh build plus direct remains 22.668683x slower. In the same run, 4,096 was 1.073641x faster in wall and used 0.956319x the CPU of 1,024. Lazy label loading also reduced direct RSS by about 134 MiB relative to the prior hosted 4,096 run.

Stage 56 arithmetic update (public synthetic n=53, no SOTA claim): runtime-gated x86_64 PCLMUL and its same-binary enabled/disabled control are now merged and archived in PRs #245–#247.

Hosted run 34712955835 used the identical algebraic factor base, public target Q=(2565091273463387,5885236316843894), four-thread 4,096-cursor collector, 85,699,806 support queries, rank endpoint, and all 189 exact group-verified relation hashes in both arms. Portable carry-less multiplication took 26.773640 wall seconds / 61.623592 core-seconds. PCLMUL took 18.872020 wall seconds / 37.858583 core-seconds: 1.418695x faster wall, 1.778660x faster collection, and a 0.614352 CPU ratio. Peak direct RSS remained about 1.392 GB.

Same-target signed-Frobenius rho took 5.116486 seconds, so PCLMUL direct remains 3.688473x slower. Fresh build plus PCLMUL direct remains 21.182086x rho. The full build + portable + PCLMUL + rho control charged 140.410989 sequential wall-seconds, 428.232650 core-seconds, and 1,709,281,280 bytes maximum sampled process-tree RSS.

Stage 58 closes the finite n=53 unknown-scalar execution gap (public synthetic, no SOTA claim).

Public seed 53001 deterministically derives Q=(221146751147987,5112896707579409), counter 0, by hash-to-curve and cofactor projection. Current n=53 public-synthetic update (selected default commit `8190f5bee6fdcee2f989125083eb2999229f4142`):

- The exact specialized pair-query batch is reproducibly faster than the generic compact batch: collection speedups 1.1884x, 1.1931x, and 1.1766x; whole direct speedups 1.0931x, 1.0812x, and 1.0764x. Each A/B retained the same 95 relation hashes, 48,531,878 support queries, 377,803 exact misses, rank solution, and recovered scalar.
- Five matched selected-stack IC/rho ratios on the same public target are 0.9465, 1.0193, 1.0950, 0.9324, and 1.0188. Two crossed; three did not. The median is 1.0188, so a reproducible full-process crossover is not established.
- The current-head run is https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34725960358. Direct was 5.227982 s, automorphism-optimized rho 5.131633 s, and peak direct RSS 1,053,990,912 B.
- An optimized public unknown-scalar run, with neither target scalar nor factor-base logs supplied, recovered 7,892,094,459,170 and verified `[d]G=Q`: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34724295607. Direct/rho was 1.2791.
- Two support-construction specializations were left opt-in after unstable or neutral repeats. The selected default keeps algebraic point-defined factor-base construction, split Bloom indices, insert-hash reuse, dual-sign denominator sharing, compact query scratch, combined n53 dispatch, and the specialized query batch.

This remains finite internal engineering/research evidence, not a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA claim. Independent reproduction and novelty review are still requested, including full cost, core-seconds, peak memory, and the same public target/rho arm.

Optimization update through Stages 94–101 (public synthetic n=53 control; no SOTA claim):

- Selected source: `4a352a8635be5be1ca21411ff83344bc145c06c6` ([PR #282](https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/282)).
- Algebraic factor base is unchanged: 9,964 points / 94 orbit columns, selected without scalar labels or target-subgroup enumeration; all 95 factor-base/target logs are derived from verified relations.
- Stage 94 selected direct-bit x filtering, prefiltered exact lookup, and Itoh–Tsujii inversion: 5.09% matched wall reduction and 6.96% core reduction with identical relation hashes ([run 34728292833](https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34728292833)).
- Stage 100 preserves every exact reference check while reusing fixed-base doubling tables: 3.05x faster solution validation, 2.82x faster independent relation replay, 8.50% median process-wall reduction, and 0.9320x same-run rho wall ([run 34730900638](https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34730900638)).
- Stage 97, on a slower-rho host class, had five online direct wins but a 0.969444 median and therefore failed the predeclared `<0.95` gate ([run 34729639001](https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34729639001)).
- Stage 101’s direct side improved further to a 4.488816 s median, but rho was 3.306672 s on that runner: zero wins and a 1.353855 median ratio ([run 34731259688](https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/actions/runs/34731259688)).
- Fresh-build ratios remain 22–28x rho, direct core cost remains above rho, licensed same-instance Magma F4 is missing, and no unaffiliated reproduction/novelty review has been received. Full-cost and SOTA gates remain false.

The rho split (about 5.1 s on some hosted runners versus 3.2–3.4 s on others) is now a material confounder. An external reproduction would be most useful if it records the exact source commit, CPU model/microcode, process affinity, all five paired wall/core/RSS results, and whether every relation hash and recovered scalar verifies. Please use `CONCUR`, `QUALIFIED`, or `BREAKS` with the source pin and evidence bundle.

Update: the selected n=53 exact-support path has a new four-shard, direct-x-routed support table, merged through PRs #286, #287, and #289. - Four additional Stage 106 runs 34733871575, 34733875815, 34733877739, and 34733880006: direct routing beat mixed routing in all 5 total runs, median wall ratio 0.904540 and median core ratio 0.912199. Direct beat matched automorphism-optimized rho in all 5, median direct/rho 0.905680, across EPYC 7763, EPYC 9V74, and Xeon Platinum 8573C receipts.
- Selected host panel run 34734274502 (AMD EPYC 9V74): five direct/rho ratios 0.847095, 0.858937, 0.839190, 0.829081, 0.838930; median 0.839190.
- Public-hash unknown-scalar run 34734272952 (AMD EPYC 7763): recovered scalar verified only by [d]G = Q, with direct 4.307977 s versus rho 4.362556 s, ratio 0.987489. Factor-base logs were not known by construction.

The unfavorable accounting remains explicit: the selected panel's fresh-build-plus-direct ratio is 17.636692, direct core cost and roughly 1 GB RSS remain above rho, licensed same-instance Magma is absent, and no independent reproduction or novelty review has been received. This is an online engineering crossover, not a full-cost or SOTA claim.

Could an unaffiliated maintainer reproduce the workflows from current `main` and report CPU identity, exact run URL, and any novelty concerns?

Single-target reproduction update: PR #545 is green and approved at head `5e01bbef`.

Review surface: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/545

Exact scalar-blind input: `docs/ic/params/k0n53-subgroup-one-unit-public-unknown.json`

```sh
cargo build --release --bin ic
target/release/ic workflow \
  --params docs/ic/params/k0n53-subgroup-one-unit-public-unknown.json \
  --dir /tmp/k0n53-public-unknown
```

The public hash input derives `Q=(221146751147987,5112896707579409)` without constructing or supplying its scalar. The algebraic subgroup-orbit factor base has 36,464 points and 344 signed-Frobenius columns; no factor-base logs are known by construction. Every retained run derives the logs from 588 verified relations, recovers `d=7892094459170`, and accepts it only after `[d]G=Q`.

Five fresh parallel runs gave 4/5 whole-process wall wins. Medians were 1.380 s IC and 1.589 s signed-Frobenius rho, or rho/IC 1.182. IC-only process CPU was 10.573 core-s, so this is not a total-compute crossover.

Five forced-single-core runs (`RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1`) gave median full IC 8.570 s versus 1.599 s rho, IC/rho 5.362, 10.984 total process core-s, 68.5 MB RSS, and a 1.008 wall/core ratio.

The target-independent relation-seed/rank search is charged separately: 45 through-logs processes, 77.960 sequential wall-seconds, 484.310 core-seconds, and 106.9 MB peak RSS. Charging that discovery to a first-ever target eliminates the selected-run wall crossover.

The retained evidence also contains the exact seed screen, 2–14 thread diagnostic, matched predecessor controls, and an independent 32-target amortization control. We request an unaffiliated reproduction of the single-target parameter file and a source-pinned novelty/correctness assessment. A `CONCUR`, `QUALIFIED`, or `BREAKS` verdict with the source commit, host/CPU, raw report, and any methodological concerns would directly address the remaining external-review gate.

The project conclusion remains: finite public-synthetic engineering evidence, not a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA result. Licensed same-instance Magma and a one-target total-core crossover are still missing.

Single-target n=59 reproduction update (public synthetic; no SOTA claim):

Review PR: https://github.com/aburan28/crypto/pull/580
Evidence head: `117f758c`
Exact parameter file: `docs/ic/params/k1n59-cofactor-projected-l15-witnessed-full-public-59001.json`

The factor base is target-independent: it applies the public cofactor to the standard ell=15 polynomial subspace, removes the identity, and deduplicates point identities. It has 32,934 subgroup points and 16,344 unknown log columns. It does not enumerate the target subgroup, retain scalar preimages, use known factor-base logs, or construct the target scalar.

The witnessed-compact table stores a packed pair beside each compact rest and rechecks every candidate by exact group addition. Default-thread and one-worker runs reproduce the same 54,749-relation SHA-256 `e2004ac6e81979caf984e4fa745dc1a1ee99d13892a3f60615a5662179e3ad99`, derive all logs, recover `d=17861472351607` for public hash seed 59001, and verify `[d]G=Q`.

Measured full costs:
- default: 85.747666 s IC wall, 853.002930 core-s, 6,565,560,320 B peak RSS; rho 0.561856 s; IC/rho 152.615x
- one worker: 724.574469 s IC wall, 720.258242 core-s, 6,253,510,656 B peak RSS; rho 0.544967 s; IC/rho 1,329.575x

This improves the prior ell=15 compact run by 32.16% default wall and 28.23% one-worker wall, at about 1.5x memory. Full cost remains far behind automorphism-optimized rho. Licensed same-instance Magma and independent novelty/reproduction review remain absent.

An unaffiliated replay from the PR head, with CPU identity, wall/core/RSS, relation hash, recovered scalar, and a source-pinned `CONCUR`, `QUALIFIED`, or `BREAKS` assessment, would directly address the remaining external-review gate.

Default and one-worker workflows recover `d=17861472351607` and verify `[d]G=Q`.

- uniform work falls from 2.6M probes / 2.6624B scans to 2.5M / 2.56B plus 10,000 direct lookups

cargo run --release --bin ic -- --json workflow \

python3 scripts/compose_koblitz_stage138_gate_audit.py verify \

A source-pinned `CONCUR`, `QUALIFIED`, or `BREAKS` response remains welcome. This update does not claim a SOTA: Magma F4, one inherited preliminary resource receipt, the rho crossover, and unaffiliated reproduction/novelty review remain open.

Attribution correction to the Stage 138 update above (performance and relation stream are unchanged): the selected 15-unit execution never reached the new least-represented-column rank phase.

The persisted attempt counts are 58, 49, 36, 30, 24, 20, 16, 12, 10, 6, then eight rounds of 4, then 1 and 1. A rank phase would select exactly 64 columns once raw coverage was empty. Every selected attempt therefore came from the raw-uncovered-column branch.

I ran a new control with `targeted_tail_rank_columns` disabled. It reproduced all 295 attempts, 71 targeted relations, the sparse report, and the canonical combined hash `32cb1609d40513a12750254ba291fb2a8a262a6eaeb05e598b28212a53fbf3aa` exactly.
